qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the Bowden cable on the shift tower/transmission?
What torque should be applied to the clamping screw on the shift lever?
How much torque is required for the switch to shift console connection?
Which automatic transmission shift mechanism component requires the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The Bowden cable on shift tower/transmission requires the highest torque at 15 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which component has the lowest torque specification in the shift console automatic transmission section?
qa_pairs.answer: The switch to shift console connection has the lowest torque specification at 4.5 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Do the shift console to tunnel and interlock cable on shift tower have the same torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both the shift console to tunnel and interlock cable on shift tower have the same torque specification of 7 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What type designation applies to all the shift console automatic transmission components listed?
qa_pairs.answer: All components are designated as type 'All'

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection number covers the shift console automatic transmission specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 25-2 Shift Mechanism, subsection 25 16 Shift Console - Automatic Transmission
